offence_note: Sexual offences against two young girls, one his daughter
sentence_quote: we would substitute four years for the five years imposed by the trial judge
note: Appeal court held offence was not a hate crime; ancillary orders not shown.

offence_note: Fraud over $5,000 against employer, over $1 million
sentence_quote: I intend to endorse the Crown's submission by imposing a sentence of six years' imprisonment.
note: DNA and prohibition orders declined; no record and character given limited weight.

offence_note: Sexual assault, sexual assault with weapon, unlawful confinement
note: Appeal only about refusal to withdraw guilty pleas; sentence not yet imposed.

offence_note: Eight sexual offence counts; breach of long-term supervision order
sentence_quote: We find his decision to designate Mr. Bailey as a dangerous offender and sentence him to indeterminate sentences as being perfectly reasonable.
note: Dangerous offender designation upheld; racism raised only about Crown comment at trial.

offence_note: Fraud under $5,000, forgery, uttering forged document, attempted fraud
sentence_quote: the judge sentenced the appellant to a six month CSO on each count, the CSOs to be served concurrently one to another
note: Four concurrent six month CSOs with house arrest then curfew; discharge sought and refused.

offence_note: Possession of loaded prohibited firearm; impaired driving; other offences
sentence_quote: allow the appeal to the extent only that the sentence on the firearm charge (Information No. 202665-1) be reduced to 33 months, reflecting credit on a 1:1.5 basis for time spent in custody pre-trial
note: Pre-credit total inferred as 34 months plus 2 months; credit changed from 2 to 3 months.

offence_note: Sexual interference and sexual assault of a 14-15 year old
sentence_quote: I believe that a period of incarceration of 14 months represents an appropriate balance considering the severity of the offence as well as the aggravating and mitigating circumstances.
note: Victim surcharge waived; s.743.21 no-contact order during incarceration; s.161 for 20 years.

offence_note: Assault with a weapon (knife and scissors)
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal and reduce the sentence to one of time served.
note: Original sentence two years less a day; reduced given rehabilitation efforts and time already served.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking of many drugs; peace officer corruptly accepting drugs and money
sentence_quote: an appropriate sentence for these offences will total 4 years and 9 months imprisonment
note: Sheriff; all sentences concurrent; $1875 forfeited; victim surcharge declined.

offence_note: Marihuana production and possession for trafficking
sentence_quote: On Count 1, I sentence you to one year in prison for unlawful production of marihuana, contrary to s. 7(1) of the CDSA.
note: Mandatory minimum upheld; co-accused Picard acquitted; victim surcharge waived.
